Subject: Driftly POC wrap – numbers + quick quote / 15m call?

Hi Ashley / Mitch,

Thanks again for running the week-long POC with us — appreciate the team's time. Quick recap of the measured outcomes from our end (attached csv + token-cost snapshot):

- Latency: median p95 inference latency down from ~420ms to ~275ms (≈35% reduction) for the typical 512-token chat flow.
- Throughput: 2.8x steady-state throughput using our batching + KV cache tuning (measured at 4x load).
- Cost: modeled per-response token cost estimated at $0.032 per 1k tokens with the quantized v2 runtime enabled (compare: baseline reference estimate $0.087).
- Error rate: end-to-end 0.6% failed responses (timeouts/circuit-break), down from 2.2% during early tuning.

We documented the exact test vectors and traffic profile in the csv and included a small chart for token-cost drivers. Overall the results suggest a clear ops/cost win if you opt for the dedicated runtime.

Marketing asked whether you’d be willing to share a very short endorsement: two lines we could use in a case study and a 15-minute check-in to capture a few on-record comments. If that works, can we schedule 15 minutes next week? Alternatively, a one- or two-sentence blurb in reply would be perfect.

Suggested next steps (pick one):
1) 15-min sync next Tue/Wed (I can send a calendar invite) — capture on-record quote and a quick screenshot.
2) Reply with a 1–2 line blurb we can attribute to Driftly (marketing will review).

Thanks — happy to run through any of the numbers live if helpful.

Best,
Jonas Weber

jonas@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
